members.title: Former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon enters witness box in Sydney double murder trial
members.lead: Lamarre-Condon gives evidence in court after pleading not guilty to murdering Jesse Baird and Luke Davies in early 2024 Live updates: Beau Lamarre-Condon gives evidence in murder trial Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Former officer Beau Lamarre-Condon has alleged he heard homophobic abuse when working for New South Wales police, as the 31-year-old gave evidence in his double murder trial in Sydney. Lamarre-Condon is accused of fatally shooting couple Jesse Baird and Luke Davies with his police service weapon in Baird’s Paddington home on 19 February 2024. Continue reading...

members.title: Beau Lamarre-Condon trial live updates: accused double murderer gives evidence in high-profile case
members.lead: Lamarre-Condon has told the court he posted a bouquet of flowers on to his story around mid-November 2023 while Baird was in Melbourne. He says it was to give the impression it was from Baird and wanted to see if another man Baird was seeing would message him and say, “well I’m also dating Jesse”. Asked if he had gone through Baird’s phone around this time, Lamarre-Condon tells the court he looked at Baird’s messages with that other man while the TV presenter was in the shower. Baird later called Lamarre-Condon and asked if he went through his phone to block someone: I denied, denied, denied … within 10 hours of denying it I essentially came clean. He and Baird went back and forth about the flower messages, he tells the court: I told Jesse the flowers were sent to my mum by her partner … that wasn’t true. I then sent a voice not by text message, saying yes I did block [the man] on your phone, that was to try to insinuate they were from you when they weren’t. I completely owned up to it
